Agent Name: Orchestrator (thought)
Step Number: 66
Reason for Mistake: The orchestrator continued using a keyword filter ("numpy.polynomial") instead of the proper repository label ("component: numpy.polynomial") together with "06 - Regression" and closed status, misinterpreting the scope of “numpy.polynomial issue.” This misuse of correct data defined the wrong candidate set and led to selecting a 2022 issue rather than the true oldest (2018). By setting the search criteria incorrectly at this step, subsequent steps followed an incorrect path, making recovery unlikely.
